lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five distinct vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gills, with each column containing 2-4 primary blobs situated between the major longitudinal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal carinae to form a grid-like pattern, with the high-luminance blobs positioned at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and lower-intensity shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple small, slender teleost fish (likely remoras) is visible positioned ventrally to the primary pectoral fin and along the posterior ventral flank.
